doc:
# Celestial — Amplitudes

Unformalized claims gathered verbatim from [wiphy.org](https://wiphy.org/) (query: “celestial amplitude holography”).

claims.name: decomposition_underwrites_scatteringamplitude_celestial_cft
claims.statement: The decomposition underwrites the scattering-amplitude to celestial CFT correlation-function correspondence used in celestial holography.

claims.name: dozz_small_expansion_generates_looplevel
claims.statement: The DOZZ small-$b$ expansion generates loop-level corrections to the tree-level three-gluon scattering amplitude in celestial holography.

sources.title: Small-$b$ expansion of the DOZZ formula for light operators

claims.name: authors_apply_dozz_expansion_formulate
claims.statement: The authors apply this DOZZ expansion to formulate a perturbative Liouville program for celestial holography, which generates loop-level corrections to the tree-level three-gluon scattering amplitude.

sources.title: Small-$b$ expansion of the DOZZ formula for light operators

claims.name: paper_derives_bar_deformed_soft
claims.statement: The paper derives a $T\bar T$-deformed soft graviton theorem using celestial holography. As a concrete amplitude-level example, it shows that a two-dimensional irrelevant $T\bar T$ deformation can be implemented on a four-dimensional theory.
